name: Campaign Sandbox
description: Generates campaign route options, simulates personas, scores strategies, and produces a recommendation.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief Trigger
nodes.description: Accepts a campaign brief as input.

nodes.label: Brief Parser
nodes.description: Extracts goals, audience, and constraints from the campaign brief.

nodes.label: Route Generator
nodes.description: Generates three distinct campaign route options from the parsed brief.

nodes.label: Persona Simulator
nodes.description: Simulates target persona responses to each campaign route.

nodes.label: Route Scorer
nodes.description: Scores each route based on persona resonance, brand fit, and feasibility.

nodes.label: Strategic Critic
nodes.description: Reviews scored routes and identifies the strongest strategic recommendation.

nodes.label: Campaign Recommendation
nodes.description: The final recommendation as a structured JSON report.
